name: Ball breaks through twelve rings
looks: A small ball on a tether orbits inside twelve nested rings, each with one open gap. Every time the ball reaches a ring's gap it passes through in a burst of tiny particles, that ring fades away, a caption counts down the rings left, and the whole glow shifts a step around the colour wheel from magenta through violet to cyan. Each pass happens a touch faster than the last.
build: Concentric arcs with seeded gap angles; the ball orbits on the innermost active ring's radius, tether line to centre. Pass triggers a small particle burst, fades that ring's opacity to 0 over ~250ms, steps the counter text and the hue. Orbit speed increases ~5% per ring so the sequence visibly accelerates toward the end.
sound: One note per ring stepping up a pentatonic scale, so the full run of rings plays as a short rising melody; a soft swoosh under each orbit pass.
prompt: Loop an object orbiting inside a stack of concentric gapped rings, breaking through one ring's gap at a time with a small particle burst, a counter ticking down and the colour palette stepping forward on every pass, the pace quickening as fewer rings remain. Good for any countdown, unlock sequence or multi-step build toward a payoff.
